_meta.purpose: AI image generation prompts for species page placeholder images still needed. Use with DALL·E, Midjourney, or similar. Match vegetation and animal realism. Terrain and vegetation based on public/images/Facebook/IMAGE_INVENTORY.txt.
_meta.vegetationContext: MIWESU Game Farm, Makoppa district, Thabazimbi, Limpopo. Arid Sweet Bushveld: flat terrain only. Ground: dry reddish-brown soil, dry dusty or sandy earth, dry straw or golden-brown grass, patchy green grass. Trees: acacia-like flat-topped thorn trees, gnarled dark-bark trees, silhouetted trees on flat horizon only, sparse trees, low scrub, thorny shrubs, dense bushveld thickets. Sky: flat horizon, pale blue or golden-hour sky; distant tree line at most. No hills, no mountains, no koppies, no rocky ridges in background. Dry season savanna / open plains / wooded savanna. Warm natural light. No power lines or man-made objects in frame.
_meta.terrainRule: Background must be flat: flat horizon, distant tree line, or open sky. Never include hills, mountains, koppies, or rocky high ground in the scene.
_meta.negativeTerrain: No hills, no mountains, no koppies, no ridges, no rocky outcrops, no dramatic elevation. Landscape is flat savanna/bushveld.
_meta.vegetationDepthRule: Thick vegetation and dense bush; do not show deep open vistas or long views into the background. Background should be dense bush, thicket, shrubs or close vegetation so you cannot see far into the distance. No open horizons or distant tree lines in habitat shots; keep the scene enclosed by bush.
styleRules: Realistic, typical specimens only. Do not request 'largest', 'biggest', 'trophy', 'exceptional', 'magnificent' or show-stopper animals.
Healthy, normal-condition animals: not emaciated, not sick, not diseased. Not dying or stressed.

Match Makoppa vegetation and ground from IMAGE_INVENTORY: red-brown soil, dry golden grass, thick bush, dense thicket. Flat terrain only. Thick vegetation so background does not recede far; no long open views.
Warm wildlife photography palette. Shallow depth of field where appropriate. No blood, no gore. Dignified.
Golden hour or soft overcast preferred for wildlife. Food/venison: natural lighting, appetising but not staged.
_meta.usageNote: For habitat/wildlife prompts, vegetation and terrain match public/images/Facebook/IMAGE_INVENTORY.txt. If your image tool has a negative prompt field, add: hills, mountains, koppies, rocky ridges, dramatic elevation, mountain backdrop.
